Jerry Liu
Introducing LiteParse - the best model-free document parsing tool for AI agents 💫
介绍 LiteParse - 最佳的无模型文档解析工具，适用于 AI 代理 💫

✅ It’s completely open-source and free.
✅ No GPU required, will process ~500 pages in 2 seconds on commodity hardware
✅ More accurate than PyPDF, PyMuPDF, Markdown. Also way more readable - see below for how we parse tables!!
✅ Supports 50+ file formats, from PDFs to Office docs to images
✅ Is designed to plug and play with Claude Code, OpenClaw, and any other AI agent with a one-line skills install. Supports native screenshotting capabilities.
它完全是开源且免费的。
✅ 无需 GPU，可在普通硬件上 2 秒内处理约 500 页
✅ 比 PyPDF、PyMuPDF 和 Markdown 更准确。此外，可读性也强得多——详见下文我们如何解析表格！！
✅ 支持 50 多种文件格式，从 PDF 到 Office 文档再到图像文件
✅ 旨在与 Claude Code、OpenClaw 以及任何其他具备一行技能安装能力的 AI 代理即插即用。支持原生截图功能。

We spent years building up LlamaParse by orchestrating state-of-the-art VLMs over the most complex documents. Along the way we realized that you could get quite far on most docs through fast and cheap text parsing.
我们花了数年时间构建 LlamaParse，通过协调最先进的视觉语言模型（VLMs）来处理最复杂的文档。在此过程中，我们意识到，通过快速且低成本的文本解析，你可以在大多数文档上取得相当大的进展。

Take a look at the video below. For really complex tables within PDFs, we output them in a spatial grid that’s both AI and human-interpretable. Any other free/light parser light PyPDF will destroy the representation of this table and output a sequential list.
看看下面的视频。对于 PDF 文件中非常复杂的表格，我们以空间网格的形式输出它们，这种网格既可以被 AI 理解，也可以被人类理解。任何其他免费/轻量级解析器（比如轻量级的 PyPDF）都会破坏该表格的呈现形式，并输出一个顺序列表。

This is not a replacement for a VLM-based OCR tool (it requires 0 GPUs and doesn’t use models), but it is shocking how good it is to parse most documents.
这不是基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的 OCR 工具的替代品（它无需 GPU 且不使用模型），但它解析大多数文档的效果之好令人震惊。

Huge shoutout to @LoganMarkewich
and @itsclelia
for all the work here.
特别感谢 @LoganMarkewich 和 @itsclelia ，感谢他们在这里的所有工作。

Come check it out: https://llamaindex.ai/blog/liteparse-local-document-parsing-for-ai-agents?utm_source=xjl&utm_medium=social…
Repo: https://github.com/run-llama/liteparse…
来看看： https://llamaindex.ai/blog/liteparse-local-document-parsing-for-ai-agents?utm_source=xjl&utm_medium=social…
仓库: https://github.com/run-llama/liteparse…
@llama_index

We've spent years building LlamaParse into the most accurate document parser for production AI. Along the way, we learned a lot about what fast, lightweight parsing actually looks like under the hood. Today, we're open-sourcing a light-weight core of that tech as LiteParse 🦙
我们花了数年时间将 LlamaParse 构建成最精准的生产 AI 文档解析器。在此过程中，我们深入了解了快速、轻量级解析在内部究竟是什么样子的。 今天，我们将该技术的轻量级核心开源，命名为 LiteParse 🦙

编辑：*markitdown 不是 markdown

great work! Thanks!!!
干得好！谢谢！！！

@Jerry Liu ♥ 2 · 💬 1

if you have feedback let us know!
如果你有反馈，请告诉我们！

@Jerry Liu ♥ 0 · 💬 2

1. yeah the primary goal is for AI to understand the text, so we cared less about specific markdown formatting and way more about whether LLMs could answer questions/solve tasks given the context

(this is also why our outputs don't do well over olmocr/omnidoc, which evaluate on
嗯，主要目标是让 AI 理解文本，所以我们不太在意特定的 Markdown 格式，而更侧重于 LLMs 能否在给定的上下文中回答问题或解决任务。

这也是为什么我们的输出在 olmocr/omnidoc 上表现不佳，而这些（系统/工具）在...方面进行评估

@Utkarsh Singh ♥ 1 · 💬 1

choosing open-source is smart. but how do you tackle support or issues users might face with it?
选择开源是明智的。但是你如何处理用户可能遇到的支持或问题？
